# FixThePhoto

> > Professional photo and video editing resources including free LUTs, Photoshop plugins, and online editing tools for photographers and videographers.

FixThePhoto provides comprehensive editing resources for Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and other creative software, alongside free online tools like AirBrush Photo Editor. The site specializes in color grading presets, retouching plugins, and professional editing tutorials for both photography and video production workflows.

## Key Topics

- LUTs (Lookup Tables)
- Color Grading
- Adobe Premiere Pro
- Adobe Photoshop
- Video Editing
- Photo Retouching
- Cinematic Effects
- Portrait Editing
- Photoshop Plugins
- Online Photo Editing
- Skin Smoothing
- AirBrush Photo Editor
- Free Editing Presets
- Professional Photography Tools

## Online Photo Editing Tools

- [Free Online AirBrush Photo Editor](https://fixthephoto.com/airbrush-photo-editor.html): Online photo editor with portrait retouching and skin smoothing tools

## Video Color Grading Resources

- [150 Free LUTs for Premiere for Video Editing](https://fixthephoto.com/luts-for-premiere): Free LUT collection for Adobe Premiere Pro video color grading (.cube/.look)
- [120 Free Blackmagic LUTs – Download Now!](https://fixthephoto.com/blackmagic-luts): Free Blackmagic LUT pack for video color grading in Premiere/FCPX/Vegas

## Photoshop Extensions & Plugins

- [70 FREE Photoshop Plugins for Photographers to Get Amazing Results](https://fixthephoto.com/free-photoshop-plugins.html): Collection of 70 free Photoshop plugins for photographers and retouchers
